## Agent CLI: MCP delivery (Cursor)

This run uses the `cursor-agent` command definition. MCP is enabled through a `config_file` mechanism: the workflow handler writes a workspace-relative MCP server config file under the spoke before spawn and restores any prior bytes afterward. Cursor ignores MCP configuration supplied only through the child environment; the on-disk config file is required for this binary.
